title: Named effects and shader slots
blurb: <canvas-slot effect="tilt"> draws each slot as a texture through a named fragment shader, or one you write, with CSS custom properties as its inputs. You don't write a render loop.
question: Can <canvas-slot> apply a shader to each slot without the page author writing a render loop?

glContexts.why: known: each canvas-slot effect has its own WebGL context when WebGPU is not used (8 here).
